rules.title: Game Rules & Introduction
rules.template:
# Game Rules

## Introduction
Welcome to this gamebook adventure! Below you will find the fundamental rules and mechanics required to play.

## How to Play
Read each paragraph and make your choices. At the end of each passage, you will find options leading to subsequent paragraph numbers (§).

## Character Traits & Stats
During your journey, your character relies on attributes and parameters:
- **Health / Condition**: Keep track of your vitals — reaching zero means defeat.
- **Primary Stats**: Used when rolling skill and trait checks.

## Dice Rolls & Checks
When the game calls for a test (e.g., *Agility Check*), roll your dice and compare the result against your character stat.

## Combat
Encounters with opponents follow the guidelines provided in paragraph combat blocks.

## Inventory
Record acquired weapons, armor, and quest items in your backpack slots.
